FuelBox nutrition calculator — test screenshots (1–16)

Tests 1–8 are the eight calculation cases taken through to the result screen (kcal / protein / carbs / fat / fiber shown in each caption); tests 9–16 are the error cases. Each image shows the inputs and the outcome together. On the error tests, every message also pops up as a toast at the top of the screen, in addition to the red text under each field.

Formula as specified: BMR (Mifflin–St Jeor) × (day base + workout add), then the goal factor, floored at 1500 kcal (male) / 1200 kcal (female) and rounded to 10. Height and weight each carry a small cm / ft and kg / lb switch; the “Workouts per week” question is back, and blank submits now surface 9 errors.
